title: From Dream to Income: The New Era of Yacht Ownership
description: Owning a yacht isn’t just a dream reserved for the ultra-wealthy—it can also be a smart financial move. With today’s flexible ownership models and growing charter opportunities, it’s easier than ever to invest in a yacht that works for you. Discover how you can enjoy the luxury lifestyle while generating income from your vessel.
html:
If you’ve ever dreamed of owning a yacht and making it work for you financially, now is the time

The USA Just Made Buying a Yacht a Great Investment

If you’ve ever dreamed of owning a yacht and making it work for you financially, now is the time.

Thanks to the 2025 OBBBA, 100% Bonus Depreciation is back.

That means:

✅ Buy the Yacht of your Dreams

✅ Open a Charter LLC to reduce operating costs

✅ Deduct up to 100% of the purchase price from your yearly income tax

Example: Buy a yacht for $250,000? You will receive a tax credit on your Tax Bracket. If you are in a 35% Tax Bracket, You Can receive a $87,500 Tax credit.

At FYI Yachts, we are here to assist you:

· Find the right boat for you.

· Guide you in your LLC, so that you can take advantage of this amazing opportunity.
